text:
Elaine: Heads-up — planning a late-afternoon rollout today (kernel + new quant profile v2.1) for serving runtime. target window 16:30-17:30 PT. Looking for an owner for slot claim + smoke runs. No infra changes, just runtime binary + quant profile swap.
Raj: I can own the slot claim and rollback steps. available 16:15 onwards.
Mike: I can run the smoke checklist and do the quick perf sanity (latency p50/p95) after canary.
Elaine: thanks. Nora, can you monitor metrics + traces during the rollout? need quick callouts if errors spike.
Nora: yep, I'll watch traces and tail error logs. will set alerts to high-sensitivity for the hour.
Raj: plan: 1) claim canary slot 2) deploy kernel+profile to canary (5%), 3) run smoke tests, 4) expand by 25% slices every 6m if green. rollback if error rate >1% or tail latency > 2x baseline.
Mike: smoke checklist (quick):
```
# health
curl -s https://runtime.prod.internal/health | jq .status
# sample gen
curl -s -X POST https://runtime.prod.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":8}' | jq .choices[0].text
# kv cache sanity (sample key)
rwtl kv-get --model rdx-small --key test-prefix
# quant profile check
rwtl inspect --model rdx-small --profile v2.1
```
Elaine: deployment notes: - no DB migrations - KV cache invalidation not required for this profile, but we will monitor cache hit rate. - metrics dashboard: /dashboards/eng/runtime/quant-rollouts
Raj: rollback is config-driven: set ENV RUNTIME_FORCE_PROFILE=previous and flip the kernel tag back to v202.7. command on ops node: `rwtl rollback --slot $SLOT --to-tag v202.7`
Nora: will shortlink dashboards and set a temporary alert: /dashboards/eng/runtime/quant-rollouts?range=1h + alert rule: runtime_errors > 1% over 2m
Mike: small qa note — please don't expand to global until regional perf looks good. start with us-west only.
Elaine: agreed. owner timeline: Raj claims slot at 16:15, canary deploy 16:30, smoke 16:35-16:45, expand 16:45-17:15, final checks 17:15-17:30.
Raj: claimed slot. I'll post status updates in this thread.
deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: job_id=deploy-1729456789-canary, owner=Raj. ETA 16:30 PT.
Mike: quick code review ping — PR #6241 (runtime: quant profile switch) is approved and merged. cc @Elaine.
Elaine: perfect. if anyone sees >0.5% new errors in first 6m, call the rollback immediately. use `@oncall` if manual paging needed.
Nora: monitoring set. creating a tiny dashboard with baseline overlays.
Raj: canary started. running smoke commands now. will paste logs in 2m.
Mike: running perf script — p50 baseline 18ms, p95 baseline 120ms. will compare after canary.
Raj: smoke results: health ok, sample gen ok, kv-get ok, profile shows v2.1. no errors in logs so far. :thumbsup:
Nora: traces look clean. small bump in CPU but within expected. no error spike.
Elaine: expanding to 30% now.
Raj: expansion complete to 55% slices. all green.
Mike: perf after expansion p50 20ms, p95 130ms — within target.
Nora: alerting quiet. removing high-sensitivity override at 17:25.
Elaine: final: full rollout scheduled for tomorrow morning to avoid peak traffic. for now, this region is on v2.1 and kernel v202.8. great work team.
Raj: rolling up notes to the runbook: https://go/runbooks/runtime/1729456789
Mike: +1, will follow up with a short post-deploy check in tomorrow.
Elaine: thanks everyone. thread closed for now. :party:
